ov: Eight species of large water birds with a long beak and a huge throat pouch, used to scoop up fish and drain out the water before swallowing. Their bills and pouches turn bright colours before the breeding season.
rg: Tropical to temperate waters on every continent except Antarctica; absent from inland Amazonia, polar regions and the open ocean.
df: Mainly fish, caught at or near the surface.
fx: After heavy rain, at least one species flies to temporary lakes in the desert of Australia’s Red Centre.
